data.name: Travel Review Ratings
data.abstract: Google reviews on attractions from 24 categories across Europe are considered. Google user rating ranges from 1 to 5 and average user rating per category is calculated.

intro_paper.title: Evaluation of Partitioning Clustering Algorithms for Processing Social Media Data in Tourism Domain
intro_paper.authors: Dr. Shini Renjith, A. Sreekumar, M. Jathavedan
intro_paper.venue: IEEE Recent Advances in Intelligent Computational Systems

additional_info.summary: This data set is populated by capturing user ratings from Google reviews. Reviews on attractions from 24 categories across Europe are considered. Google user rating ranges from 1 to 5 and average user rating per category is calculated.
